dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-m", "pytest"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with pinned versions for stability. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, copies the application code, and defaults to running pytest for testing.
